purpose: Consolidate the next evidence-backed mechanics frontier after restored-skill identity/acquisition recovery.
policy: Canonical skills.json remains authoritative. Research batches and audit artifacts are evidence layers. Source-reported numbers remain bounded by their source/version; unresolved frames, scaling, reward probabilities, and hidden gates remain null/unresolved.

records.name: Assault Rain
records.mechanics_boundary: Tracked aerial Ki-blast barrage; current evidence supports 10 hits, long range, launching behavior, and source-reported ~15% total damage.

records.name: Super Electric Strike
records.mechanics_boundary: Large tracked Ki wave; current evidence supports 17 hits, long range, knockback, and source-reported ~40% total damage.

records.name: Ki Explosion
records.mechanics_boundary: Short-range omnidirectional explosion; holding extends/repeats the explosion by consuming additional Ki, with current evidence allowing extension up to four Ki bars total. Official update history documents the historical 200→100 Ki change.

records.name: Heavenly Arrow
records.mechanics_boundary: Backward-moving 8-hit Ki barrage; forward input adds an unblockable Ki-powered hand strike and extra Ki bullet. Long-range/knockback behavior is documented.

records.name: Counter Burst
records.mechanics_boundary: Frontal Ki counter barrier; current dedicated evidence supports a 6-hit counter projectile, knockback, and 20% source-reported damage when triggered by a Ki Blast skill. Exact counter window, complete coverage, frame data, and patch-independent scaling remain unresolved.
unresolved: exact coverage of countered Ki attacks

records.name: Shooting Strike
records.mechanics_boundary: Ranged Gamma 1 ray-gun projectile followed on connection by a flying-kick follow-up; current repository evidence maintains the PQ156 endpoint and source-reported 10% damage.

records.name: Apocalyptic Burst
records.mechanics_boundary: Ranged multi-stage Ki Blast Ultimate; current repository evidence confirms the staged burst behavior but does not establish a safe universal hit count, frame profile, scaling formula, or reward probability.

records.name: Time Skip/Jump Spike
records.mechanics_boundary: Forward rush that strikes the target; holding input extends flight range. Current evidence also records Strike immunity during the rush and Hit-training provenance, while preserving the historical lesson-description naming issue.

records.name: Gigantic Rage
records.mechanics_boundary: Grab-and-slam sequence with five ground slams and hard knockdown on the final slam; source reports 15% total damage. Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan)'s use includes Super Armor, which is not generalized to Kale or Broly (DB Super).

validation.identity_scope: These records already exist in the canonical corpus; this pass does not create duplicate identities.
validation.pq_boundary: Acquisition endpoints are not converted into PQ reward edges unless explicit reward evidence exists.
validation.mechanics_reconciliation: Batch 03 appended as evidence-only boundaries; no canonical mutation performed.
